description: What each of the ten original articles reports, for ground truth v1.2. Countries, industries and companies are those the article states as disrupted, under their knowledge-graph names where they have one. Scope 'industries': the article confines the disruption to the named industries; scope 'country': it affects the named countries as a whole. Every article reports an ongoing disruption. The type is the label that the Disruption Monitor's label definitions (config/tasks.yaml) give to the event that causes the disruption.

SC001.basis: Recession forcing production cuts across South Africa's Metals & Mining industry.

SC002.basis: Banking restrictions affect at least 40 registered entities across sectors; the automotive supply chain is named as particularly affected.

SC003.basis: Coordinated strike across Japan's automotive manufacturers and their parts suppliers; Toyota Industries suspends production at two plants.

SC004.basis: Crisis halting production in Argentina's chemicals industry.

SC005.basis: Crisis in Germany's automotive industry, caused by trade restrictions on Russian palladium and nickel exports; Mercedes-Benz reduces shifts. Continental AG and ZF Friedrichshafen are mentioned for a share-price fall and a profit warning, not as disrupted. Type: the disrupting event is an export restriction, which the label definitions place under Trade Policy; the geopolitical tension is its background.

SC006.basis: Cyberattack on national telecommunications infrastructure affecting banking, logistics and resources nationwide; BHP, Telstra and Optus are reported as disrupted. Optus is not in the knowledge graph.

SC007.basis: Crisis in Argentina's metals and mining sector; Ternium Argentina closes its integrated steel complex. The stored scenario lists Metals & Mining only.

SC008.basis: Production halt at North Korea's aircraft manufacturer. The stored scenario lists 'Aerospace', which is not a knowledge-graph industry; North Korea and the company are not in the knowledge graph. Type: the halt follows structural defects in manufactured components, which fit none of the specific labels; the tension on the peninsula is background.

SC009.basis: Economic crisis reducing industrial output across the region; Hungary, Romania and Bulgaria are named as particularly affected. The stored scenario lists 'Eastern Europe', which is not a country.

SC010.basis: Flooding shuts down major steel manufacturing facilities in southeastern Australia.
